replay_note: Every solved coefficient at every level matches the production finite solve bitwise, including full eagle and float64 profiles. The corrected replay uses the same capacity-based serial/tiled sparse product selection.
derivative_tests: CPU/CUDA, float32/64 directional derivatives through sample preparation, density/normal splats, normal loads, constraints, FEM/direct screening, finite MG/cascadic solves, cumulative/device-transform field evaluation and isovalue; public field and dense/sparse MC vertex losses reach input points/normals with assignments/stopping/topology checked. Repeated/composed tapes, streams, cancelled groups, omitted NaN normals and one tracked input tested.
large_invariants: Each enabled benchmark checks finite point/normal gradients, global translation against negative query spatial gradients, and zero derivative under uniform normal-magnitude scaling. Per-run values are in the performance report.
